## Figure 5a: Regulon activity heatmap using AUC binarize
```{r}
# 1. SETUP & DATA LOADING
seurat_obj <- readRDS("~/Scratch_MF/2026_Falis_et_al/ReferenceFiles/Atlases/Complete/MouseCompleteAtlas_FinalVersion_26thMay2026.rds")
eReg_raw <- read.csv("~/Scratch_MF/ATAC/sc_Mm/scenic_complete_final_AddressingNaN/Data/scenicplus_output/eRegulon_direct.tsv", sep = "\t") 
auc_binary <- read.csv("~/Scratch_MF/ATAC/sc_Mm/scenic_complete_final_AddressingNaN/Data/scenicplus_output/BinarizedMtx_AUCBinarize_MedianPerCellType.csv", check.names = FALSE) # Verified - only +/+ regulons present

# 2. HELPER: RNA VALIDATION
get_expressed_tfs <- function(seurat_obj, threshold = 0.5) {
  avg_exp <- AverageExpression(seurat_obj, group.by = "cell.type.short", slot = "data")$RNA
  as.data.frame(avg_exp) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "expression") %>%
    filter(expression > threshold) %>%
    select(cell_type, gene, expression)
}

# Filters TFs to only those expressed above a certain threshold
get_expressed_tfs <- function(seurat_obj, threshold = 0.5) {
  avg_exp <- AverageExpression(seurat_obj, group.by = "cell.type.short", slot = "data")$RNA
  as.data.frame(avg_exp) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "expression") %>%
    filter(expression > threshold) %>%
    select(cell_type, gene, expression)
}

# 3. CORE PROCESSING LOGIC
rna_valid <- get_expressed_tfs(seurat_obj)
rna_valid$gene <- sub("^[^-]+-", "", rna_valid$gene)
 
active_regulons <- auc_binary %>%
  pivot_longer(-cell.type.short, names_to = "eRegulon", values_to = "active") %>%
  mutate(eRegulon = gsub(pattern = "_.*", replacement = '', x = eRegulon)) %>% 
  inner_join(rna_valid, by = c("cell.type.short" = "cell_type", "eRegulon" = "gene"))

# 4. EVALUATING
test <- active_regulons %>% 
  dplyr::select(-expression) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = cell.type.short, names_from = eRegulon, values_from = active) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0))) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(cell.type.short %in% c("GlyT", "JZTP", "STGC", "SpT", "LaTP", "SynTI", "SynTII")) %>%
  column_to_rownames("cell.type.short") %>%
  dplyr::select(where(~ sum(.x) > 0))

## Providing a custom order to rows
order <- colSums(test) %>% sort(decreasing = T) %>% names() # coarse order to be refined below
order <- c("Ahctf1", "Nr6a1", "Gata3", "Tfap2c", "Klf13", "Tcf12", "Pparg", "Arntl", "Mxi1", "Gata2", "Nr2f2", "Rora", "Grhl2", "Elk3", "Etv6", "Tead1", "Plagl1", "Ets2", "Irf2", "Tcf4", "Prdm1", "Nfib", "Cdx2", "Ascl2", "Ebf2", "E2f3", "Pbx3", "Max", "Ikzf2", "Rxra", "Bach2", "Smad3", "Cebpb", "Irf3", "Nfat5", "Npas2", "Dlx3", "Pax8", "Gcm1", "Trp63")

## Sanity check
answer <- all(colnames(test) %in% order)
answer2 <- length(colnames(test)) == length((order))
if (answer == FALSE | answer2 == FALSE) {
  stop("ERROR: check the labels again")
} else {print("All good. Proceeding.")}

## Reordering
test <- test[,order]

# 5. Plot heatmap
png("Visuals/a_horizontal_Heatmap_Median.png", height = 1000, width = 2400, res = 300)
par(xpd=TRUE)
  pheatmap(mat = test %>% as.matrix(),
  scale = "none",
  breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
  legend = TRUE,
  legend_breaks = c(0.25, 0.75),
  legend_labels = c("Inactive", "Active"),
  name = " ",
  fontsize_row = 10,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  color = c("#E3D3B3", "#006400"), 
  clustering_distance_rows = "binary", 
  clustering_distance_cols = "binary",
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  border_color = "black",
  angle_col = "90")
dev.off()

# 5. Plot heatmap
pdf("Visuals/a_horizontal_Heatmap_Median.pdf", height = 10, width = 24)
par(xpd=TRUE)
  pheatmap(mat = test %>% as.matrix(),
  scale = "none",
  breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
  legend = TRUE,
  legend_breaks = c(0.25, 0.75),
  legend_labels = c("Inactive", "Active"),
  name = " ",
  fontsize_row = 20,
  fontsize_col = 20,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  color = c("#E3D3B3", "#006400"), 
  clustering_distance_rows = "binary", 
  clustering_distance_cols = "binary",
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  border_color = "black",
  angle_col = "90")
dev.off()

## Concluding 
#rm(list = ls())
```
## Figure 5b_1: Marker enrichment (SynTI)
```{r}
## Defining variables
logFC_cut <- 1
adjp_cut <- 0.001
cell_type_of_interest <- "SynTI"
triplet_rank_perc_cutoff <- 0.5
active_regulons <- c("Ahctf1", "Nr6a1", "Klf13", "Mxi1", "Tead1", "Plagl1", "Cebpb", "Irf3", "Nfat5", "Npas2", "Dlx3", "Pax8")

## Loading relevant files
seurat_obj <- readRDS("~/Scratch_MF/2026_Falis_et_al/ReferenceFiles/Atlases/Complete/MouseCompleteAtlas_FinalVersion_26thMay2026.rds")
eReg_raw <- read.csv("~/Scratch_MF/ATAC/sc_Mm/scenic_complete_final_AddressingNaN/Data/scenicplus_output/eRegulon_direct.tsv", sep = "\t") 
auc_binary <- read.csv("~/Scratch_MF/ATAC/sc_Mm/scenic_complete_final_AddressingNaN/Data/scenicplus_output/BinarizedMtx_AUCBinarize_MedianPerCellType.csv", check.names = FALSE) # Verified - only +/+ regulons present
markers <- read.table(file = "~/Scratch_MF/2026_Falis_et_al/ReferenceFiles/MarkerLists/Complete/MouseCompleteAtlas_ByCellType_MinPct0.15_MinDiffPct0.15_MinLogFC0.5_PosOnly_13thAug2026.txt")

# 2. HELPER: RNA VALIDATION
get_expressed_tfs <- function(seurat_obj, threshold = 0.5) {
  avg_exp <- AverageExpression(seurat_obj, group.by = "cell.type.short", slot = "data")$RNA
  as.data.frame(avg_exp) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "expression") %>%
    filter(expression > threshold) %>%
    select(cell_type, gene, expression)
}

# Filters TFs to only those expressed above a certain threshold
get_expressed_tfs <- function(seurat_obj, threshold = 0.5) {
  avg_exp <- AverageExpression(seurat_obj, group.by = "cell.type.short", slot = "data")$RNA
  as.data.frame(avg_exp) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "expression") %>%
    filter(expression > threshold) %>%
    select(cell_type, gene, expression)
}

# 3. CORE PROCESSING LOGIC
rna_valid <- get_expressed_tfs(seurat_obj)
rna_valid$gene <- sub("^[^-]+-", "", rna_valid$gene)
cell_type_expr_genes <- rna_valid %>%
  dplyr::filter(cell_type %in% cell_type_of_interest) %>%
  pull(gene)

## Filtering markers
markers$gene <- sub("^[^-]+-", "", markers$gene)
markers <- markers %>% 
  dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > logFC_cut) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < adjp_cut) %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = T)
cell_type_markers <- markers %>% 
  dplyr::filter(cluster == cell_type_of_interest) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  unique()

## Filtering the regulons to targets expressed in the cell type of interest and adjusting the regions file
region_data <- eReg_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(triplet_rank_perc = 1 - percent_rank(triplet_rank)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(triplet_rank_perc > triplet_rank_perc_cutoff) %>%
  dplyr::filter(TF %in% active_regulons) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene %in% cell_type_expr_genes) %>%
  dplyr::select(TF, Gene, triplet_rank_perc) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(TF, Gene) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(desc(triplet_rank_perc), .by_group = T) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = triplet_rank_perc, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

## Adding marker/no marker annotation
region_data <- region_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Marker = case_when(Gene %in% cell_type_markers ~ "Marker",
                                   .default = "Non-marker"))

## Counting marker/non-marker per regulon
regulon_frac <- region_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(TF, Marker) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(TF) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(frac = n / sum(n))

## Reordering the regulons by fraction of markers and plotting
level_order <- regulon_frac %>%
  dplyr::filter(Marker == "Marker") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(frac)) %>% 
  pull(TF)

## Sanity check in case there is a regulon which does not have any markers at all
check <- length(level_order) == length(unique(regulon_frac$TF))
if (check == FALSE) {
  missing_level <- active_regulons[!(active_regulons %in% level_order)]
  level_order <- append(x = level_order, values = missing_level)
  print(paste("Level", missing_level, "appended to the ordering vector"))
}

## Refactorizing and adding TF classification
regulon_frac$TF <- factor(regulon_frac$TF, levels = level_order)
regulon_frac$Marker <- factor(regulon_frac$Marker, levels = c("Non-marker", "Marker"))
regulon_frac <- regulon_frac %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Category = case_when(TF %in% c("Ahctf1", "Nr6a1", "Klf13", "Mxi1") ~ "Shared",
                                         TF %in% c("Tead1", "Plagl1") ~ "Syncytiotrophoblast-specific", 
                                         TF %in% c("Cebpb", "Irf3", "Nfat5", "Npas2", "Dlx3", "Pax8") ~ "SynTI-specific")) %>%
  ungroup()

## Specifying color and re-adjusting the elvels
cols <- c("Shared"  = "#6d6e71",
          "Syncytiotrophoblast-specific" = "grey10",
          "SynTI-specific" = "#f7941d")

regulon_frac <- regulon_frac %>%
  dplyr::mutate(TF_col = paste0("<span style='color:", cols[Category], "'>", TF, "</span>"))
tf_col_levels <- regulon_frac %>%
  distinct(TF, TF_col) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(TF, level_order)) %>%
  pull(TF_col)

regulon_frac$TF_col <- factor(regulon_frac$TF_col,
                              levels = tf_col_levels)

p1 <- ggplot(regulon_frac,
       aes(x = TF_col, y = frac, fill = Marker)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
labs(title = cell_type_of_interest,
    fill = "Marker"
  ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
        legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 45, size = 20, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", colour = "black")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Marker" = "#006400",
                               "Non-marker" = "#E3D3B3")) + 
  ylab("Fraction of regulon targets")

ggsave(filename = paste0("Visuals/b_GRN_MarkerActivity_", cell_type_of_interest, ".png"), plot = p1, width = 9, height = 9)
ggsave(filename = paste0("Visuals/b_GRN_MarkerActivity_", cell_type_of_interest, ".pdf"), plot = p1, width = 9, height = 9)


## Concluding 
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), "seurat_obj"))
```

```{r}
## Reordering the regulons by fraction of markers and plotting
level_order <- regulon_frac %>%
  dplyr::filter(Marker == "Marker") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(frac)) %>% 
  pull(TF)

## Sanity check in case there is a regulon which does not have any markers at all
check <- length(level_order) == length(unique(regulon_frac$TF))
if (check == FALSE) {
  missing_level <- active_regulons[!(active_regulons %in% level_order)]
  level_order <- append(x = level_order, values = missing_level)
  print(paste("Level", missing_level, "appended to the ordering vector"))
}

## Refactorizing and adding TF classification
regulon_frac$TF <- factor(regulon_frac$TF, levels = level_order)
regulon_frac$Marker <- factor(regulon_frac$Marker, levels = c("Non-marker", "Marker"))
regulon_frac <- regulon_frac %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Category = case_when(TF %in% c("Ahctf1", "Nr6a1", "Gata3", "Tfap2c", "Klf13", "Tcf12", "Pparg", "Mxi1", "Nr2f2", "Gata2", "Grhl2") ~ "Shared",
                                         TF %in% c("Max", "Ikzf2", "Rxra", "Bach2") ~ "STGC-specific")) %>%
  ungroup()

## Specifying color and re-adjusting the elvels
cols <- c("Shared"  = "#6d6e71",
          "STGC-specific" = "#f7941d")

regulon_frac <- regulon_frac %>%
  dplyr::mutate(TF_col = paste0("<span style='color:", cols[Category], "'>", TF, "</span>"))
tf_col_levels <- regulon_frac %>%
  distinct(TF, TF_col) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(TF, level_order)) %>%
  pull(TF_col)

regulon_frac$TF_col <- factor(regulon_frac$TF_col,
                              levels = tf_col_levels)

p1 <- ggplot(regulon_frac,
       aes(x = TF_col, y = frac, fill = Marker)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
labs(title = cell_type_of_interest,
    fill = "Marker"
  ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
        legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 45, size = 20, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", colour = "black")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Marker" = "#006400",
                               "Non-marker" = "#E3D3B3")) + 
  ylab("Fraction of regulon targets")

ggsave(filename = paste0("Visuals/b_GRN_MarkerActivity_", cell_type_of_interest, ".png"), plot = p1, width = 9, height = 9)
ggsave(filename = paste0("Visuals/b_GRN_MarkerActivity_", cell_type_of_interest, ".pdf"), plot = p1, width = 9, height = 9)
```

```{r}
markers <- read.table(file = "~/Scratch_MF/2026_Falis_et_al/ReferenceFiles/MarkerLists/Complete/MouseCompleteAtlas_ByCellType_MinPct0.15_MinDiffPct0.15_MinLogFC0.5_PosOnly_13thAug2026.txt")

# 2. HELPER: RNA VALIDATION
get_expressed_tfs <- function(seurat_obj, threshold = 0.5) {
  avg_exp <- AverageExpression(seurat_obj, group.by = "cell.type.short", slot = "data")$RNA
  as.data.frame(avg_exp) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "expression") %>%
    filter(expression > threshold) %>%
    select(cell_type, gene, expression)
}

# Filters TFs to only those expressed above a certain threshold
get_expressed_tfs <- function(seurat_obj, threshold = 0.5) {
  avg_exp <- AverageExpression(seurat_obj, group.by = "cell.type.short", slot = "data")$RNA
  as.data.frame(avg_exp) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "expression") %>%
    filter(expression > threshold) %>%
    select(cell_type, gene, expression)
}

# 3. CORE PROCESSING LOGIC
rna_valid <- get_expressed_tfs(seurat_obj)

## Filtering markers

  dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > logFC_cut) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < adjp_cut) %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = T)
cell_type_markers <- markers %>% 
  dplyr::filter(cluster == cell_type_of_interest) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  unique()

## Filtering the regulons to targets expressed in the cell type of interest and adjusting the regions file
region_data <- eReg_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(triplet_rank_perc = 1 - percent_rank(triplet_rank)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(triplet_rank_perc > triplet_rank_perc_cutoff) %>%
  dplyr::filter(TF %in% active_regulons) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene %in% cell_type_expr_genes) %>%
  dplyr::select(TF, Gene, triplet_rank_perc) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(TF, Gene) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(desc(triplet_rank_perc), .by_group = T) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = triplet_rank_perc, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

## Adding marker/no marker annotation
region_data <- region_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Marker = case_when(Gene %in% cell_type_markers ~ "Marker",
                                   .default = "Non-marker"))

## Counting marker/non-marker per regulon
regulon_frac <- region_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(TF, Marker) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(TF) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(frac = n / sum(n))

## Reordering the regulons by fraction of markers and plotting

  dplyr::filter(Marker == "Marker") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(frac)) %>%

## Sanity check in case there is a regulon which does not have any markers at all
check <- length(level_order) == length(unique(regulon_frac$TF))
if (check == FALSE) {
  missing_level <- active_regulons[!(active_regulons %in% level_order)]
  level_order <- append(x = level_order, values = missing_level)
  print(paste("Level", missing_level, "appended to the ordering vector"))
}

## Refactorizing and adding TF classification
regulon_frac$TF <- factor(regulon_frac$TF, levels = level_order)
regulon_frac$Marker <- factor(regulon_frac$Marker, levels = c("Non-marker", "Marker"))
regulon_frac <- regulon_frac %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Category = case_when(TF %in% c("Ahctf1", "Nr6a1", "Gata3", "Tfap2c", "Tcf12", "Pparg", "Arntl", "Mxi1", "Rora", "Grhl2") ~ "Shared",
                                         TF %in% c("Smad3") ~ "SpT-specific")) %>%

## Specifying color and re-adjusting the elvels

          "SpT-specific" = "#f7941d")

regulon_frac <- regulon_frac %>%
  dplyr::mutate(TF_col = paste0("<span style='color:", cols[Category], "'>", TF, "</span>"))

  distinct(TF, TF_col) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(TF, level_order)) %>%
  pull(TF_col)

regulon_frac$TF_col <- factor(regulon_frac$TF_col,
                              levels = tf_col_levels)

p1 <- ggplot(regulon_frac,
```

```{r}
# 2. HELPER: RNA VALIDATION
get_expressed_tfs <- function(seurat_obj, threshold = 0.5) {

  as.data.frame(avg_exp) %>%

# Filters TFs to only those expressed above a certain threshold

                                      Gene %in% prolactins ~ "Prolactin",

                                      .default = "Other")) %>%

## Node table: ALL TFs in active_regulons are kept, even if they have no edges
tf_nodes <- tibble(name = active_regulons,
                   node_type   = "TF",
                   node_class  = "TF",
                   tf_category = if_else(active_regulons %in% celltype_specific_tfs,
                                         "Cell-type specific",
                                         "Shared"))

  dplyr::distinct(name = Gene, node_class = highlight) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!name %in% active_regulons) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(node_type   = "Target",

  dplyr::distinct(name, .keep_all = TRUE)

)

      node_type == "TF" & name %in% celltype_specific_tfs ~ "Cell-type specific TF",

) +

    fontface = "plain",
    force = 20,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    point.padding = 0.5,
    box.padding = 1) +
  geom_node_text(

    size = 8,
    fontface = "bold",
    force = 20,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    point.padding = 0.5,
    box.padding = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Cell-type specific TF" = "#D55E00",
      "Shared TF" = "black",
      "CEA Family" = "#E69500"
    )
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Cell-type specific TF" = 15,
      "Shared TF" = 15,
      "CEA Family" = 16
    )
  ) +
  theme_graph() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20))

ggsave(filename = "Visuals/c_GRN_SpT_ExpandedFamiliesHighlighted.png", plot = p1, height = 9, width = 12)
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/c_GRN_SpT_ExpandedFamiliesHighlighted.pdf", plot = p1, height = 9, width = 12, device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
                to = Gene,
                triplet_rank_perc)

graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = node_info,
                   edges = edges_df,
                   directed = TRUE)

## Plotting
cols <- c("Shared"  = "#6d6e71",
          "Syncytiotrophoblast-specific" = "grey10",
          "SynTI-specific" = "#f7941d")

p1 <-  ggraph(graph, layout = "fr") +
  geom_edge_link(
  width = 0.8,
  colour = "black",
  alpha = 0.5,
  end_cap = circle(4, "mm"),
  arrow = arrow(
    length = unit(4, "mm"),
    type = "closed")) +
  geom_node_point(aes(fill = TF_highlight),
                  shape = 21,
                  size = 10,
                  colour = "black",
                  stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = TF),
                 repel = TRUE,
                 fontface = "bold",
                 size = 10,
                 force = 20,
                 max.overlaps = Inf,
                 point.padding = 0.5,
                 box.padding = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  theme_graph() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 20),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 23)) +
  guides(edge_width = guide_legend(title = "Triplet Rank Percentile"),
         fill = guide_legend(title = ""))

ggsave(filename = "Visuals/e_SynTINetwork.png", plot = p1, width = 9, height = 12)
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/e_SynTINetwork.pdf", plot = p1, width = 9, height = 12, device = cairo_pdf)

## Emptying the environment
rm(list = ls())
```
## Figure 5f: Syncytiotrophoblast II network
```{r}
## Defining variables
active_regulons <- c("Ahctf1", "Nr6a1", "Gata3", "Klf13", "Mxi1", "Gata2", "Tead1", "Plagl1", "Gcm1", "Trp63")
active_regulons_formatted <- paste0(active_regulons, "_direct_+/+")
triplet_rank_perc_cutoff <- 0.5

## Loading relevant files
eReg_raw <- read.csv("~/Scratch_MF/ATAC/sc_Mm/scenic_complete_final_AddressingNaN/Data/scenicplus_output/eRegulon_direct.tsv", sep = "\t") 

## Subsetting the regulon file to retain only the regulons of interest
to_plot <- eReg_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(triplet_rank_perc = 1 - percent_rank(triplet_rank)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(eRegulon_name %in% active_regulons_formatted) %>%
  dplyr::filter(triplet_rank_perc > triplet_rank_perc_cutoff) %>%
  dplyr::select(TF, Gene, triplet_rank_perc) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(TF, Gene) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(desc(triplet_rank_perc), .by_group = T) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = triplet_rank_perc, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

## Plot connections between regulons
to_plot <- to_plot %>%
  dplyr::mutate(TF_highlight = case_when(TF %in% c("Ahctf1", "Nr6a1", "Gata3", "Klf13", "Mxi1", "Gata2") ~ "Shared",
                                         TF %in% c("Tead1", "Plagl1") ~ "Syncytiotrophoblast-specific", 
                                         TF %in% c("Gcm1", "Trp63") ~ "SynTII-specific")) %>%
  ungroup()


## Creating the table for network plotting. I explicitly include all TFs, even if they have no connections to other TFs
node_info <- tibble(to_plot %>% 
         dplyr::select(TF, TF_highlight) %>%
         distinct() %>%
         dplyr::mutate(node_type = "TF"))

edges_df <- to_plot %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene %in% active_regulons) %>%
  dplyr::select(from = TF,
                to = Gene,
                triplet_rank_perc)

graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = node_info,
                   edges = edges_df,
                   directed = TRUE)

## Plotting
cols <- c("Shared"  = "#6d6e71",
          "Syncytiotrophoblast-specific" = "grey10",
          "SynTII-specific" = "#f7941d")

p1 <- ggraph(graph, layout = "fr") +
  geom_edge_link(
  width = 0.8,

  arrow = arrow(
    length = unit(4, "mm"),

  geom_node_point(aes(fill = TF_highlight),
                  shape = 21,
                  size = 10,
                  colour = "black",
                  stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = TF),
                 repel = TRUE,
                 fontface = "bold",
                 size = 10,
                 force = 20,

                 point.padding = 0.5,

  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  theme_graph() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 20),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 23)) +
  guides(edge_width = guide_legend(title = "Triplet Rank Percentile"),
```
